items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 88:1
items.html: The Partzufim are considered like the Sefirot: just as there are five aspects that are of the aspect of the light of Hochma, called KHB ZON, and there are five aspects among the ten Sefirot on the side of the light of Hassadim, called the five Hassadim, which are HGT NH — so it is also with the Partzufim, for there are five Partzufim of the aspect of the light of Hochma, which are the Partzufim of AK standing from its Tabur upward, and there are five Partzufim of the aspect of the light of Hassadim in an illumination of Hochma, which are the Partzufim of Atzilut standing below the Tabur of AK — namely the Partzufim of Nekudim and the twelve Partzufim of Atzilut. And indeed it is necessary that the light of Hochma also be in the Partzufim of Atzilut, since it is altogether impossible for the lower degrees to come out without the preceding degrees among the ten Sefirot; however, they do not shine from the aspect of the light of Hochma within them, but only in the aspect of an illumination of Hochma alone — like Bina, who shines only an illumination of Hochma to ZON. Hence, likewise, the Partzufim of Keter of Atzilut, even though they contain a level of Keter and Hochma, nevertheless do not shine from the aspect of their own essence, but only from the aspect of the Bina within them, meaning only in the aspect of an illumination of Hochma alone. Hence the Partzufim of Keter of Atzilut, too, are considered only of the aspect of Neshama alone, since they shine only from the aspect of the Neshama within them, namely only the aspect of the illumination of Hochma that belongs to ZON. Hence all five Partzufim of Atzilut are considered only of the level of NRN alone. (Inner Observation, item 15)
